title: Kusoma kwa ufasaha (Theme 10: Hali ya anga)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child finds the target words first, then reads phrase by phrase, letting the marks set the pauses and the voice.

floor.prerequisite: Reads short words with every sound clear.
floor.question: Soma: "Baba anakula."

steps: Ask a listener one question about it.
contexts: reading to a younger brother or sister

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child reads the line twice: once as a statement and once as the question.

misconceptions.ask: Sauti lengwa katika neno hili ni ipi?
Ukisoma neno moja moja, mwenzako anaelewa?
misconceptions.repair: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.

listen_for: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
misconceptions.repair: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.

misconceptions.ask: Wasikilizaji waliweza kuelewa uliposoma haraka hivyo?
misconceptions.repair: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.

listen_for: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
misconceptions.ask: Alama iliyo mwishoni mwa sentensi hii ni ipi?
misconceptions.repair: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; simama kidogo kwenye koma na kikomo.

checks.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma ni ipi?
